purpose: W9-B: extend the existing canonical PostgreSQL Dispute authority with Claim/Response/CounterEvidence, retest/survey/expert-review branches and exact partial-hold/resolution evidence without creating DisputeV2 or a second money-instruction authority.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Partial hold/release remains canonical Settlement authority. Dispute records instructions/basis only; W9-B cannot move money.
Retest consumes VerificationOrder/Lab evidence through references; it does not mutate lab authority.
Independent retest/survey/expert review is requested/referenced from the dispute but executed by the accepted verification authority.
The existing private dispute authority is extended through forward SQL and no parallel public Dispute model is created.
Global CI remains an independent gate.

requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing Dispute case/participant/evidence/appeal/money-instruction/receipt/RLS/CAS/idempotency authority; do not create DisputeV2 or another arbitration engine.

Claim is an immutable/versioned assertion tied to exact Deal/document/quality/weight/logistics/money facts and claimed remedy/amount where applicable. A claim is not proven merely because it is filed.
Response and CounterEvidence are append-only, source/provenance/version bound and participant-scoped. Neither party may delete or overwrite the other side's evidence.

Retest, survey and expert review are explicit independent-review requests with provider/method/evidence requirements and resulting VerificationOrder references; requested review is not a successful independent result.

PartialResolution records accepted/rejected issue portions and exact minor-unit hold/release instruction bases. Sum of resolved/open/disputed amount portions conserves the canonical disputed amount exactly.
Dispute cannot directly move money; it emits an immutable settlement instruction/basis that canonical Settlement validates and applies separately.
A settlement hold/release receipt must be linked back before the dispute can claim financial execution/finality. Instruction sent/queued is not money moved.
Decision/appeal history is immutable. New evidence/retest after a decision creates a new review/appeal/version branch according to policy; historical decision bytes are never rewritten.
Current Deal participant/arbitrator/support authority is revalidated before mutation and replay. Revocation prevents a historical receipt from serving as current authorization.
Cross-tenant and same-tenant outsider access to claims/evidence/private expert reports is denied except explicit role/participant authority.
Every mutation commits case version, immutable event/evidence, audit, outbox and receipt atomically with payload-bound idempotency.
No lab/survey/provider result is self-verified by upload; independent evidence authority must validate it under its own policy.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, Settlement, Verification, Document authorities and REG.RU production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove claim -> response -> counter-evidence -> independent-review request -> decision/partial-resolution flows with full immutable history.
Retest/survey/expert request without accepted verification evidence cannot be treated as completed or verified.
Partial amount cases conserve exact minor units and cannot release more than the canonical disputed/held amount.
Settlement instruction creation does not mutate payment/hold state; later receipt linkage is required to show financial execution.
Concurrent response/decision/appeal commands serialize via CAS and stale/changed-payload replay fail deterministically.
Cross-tenant/same-tenant outsider access and revoked participant/arbitrator authority fail closed before mutation and replay.
Audit/outbox/evidence failure leaves no partial accepted case transition or receipt.
Existing dispute PostgreSQL authority tests remain green; exact-head CI/review and REG.RU real dispute workflow acceptance remain required for terminal credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: W4-B generalized VerificationOrder must be accepted for independent retest/survey/expert execution.
W5-A SettlementPlan/FinancialObligation must consume dispute instructions/receipts for end-to-end partial financial resolution.
Role UI/evidence upload/read/appeal workflow and real arbitrator/party acceptance remain later UX/human acceptance.
